build_vgg_model_from_plan: build a VGG-style CIFAR-10 model by passing a layer plan list and weight initializer to Model
create_model_from_name: create a VGG model from a name string like cifar_vgg_16 using get_model_from_name
validate_model_name: validate a model name string with is_valid_model_name to check it matches cifar_vgg_11, 13, 16, or 19
get_default_hparams: get the default LotteryDesc hyperparameters for training a cifar_vgg_16 model on CIFAR-10
review_convmodule_forward: review the ConvModule forward pass that applies Conv2d, BatchNorm2d, and ReLU in sequence
